The evidence from both paths highlights a shared role of Slc25a29 in mediating transport activities, reinforcing the hypothesis that L-carnitine interacts with Slc22a5 through a mechanism involving Slc25a29. The integration of these pathways underscores a possible functional link between L-carnitine and Slc22a5, particularly in the context of membrane transport and ion homeostasis.
